name: Travel Beat Vlog
summary: Cut a travel beat vlog to your own song: two fast montages on its drum hits, a hero photo with a big title behind the people, two 2x2 grids on the beat, per-slot reference colour and a fade.

compatibility.selects: Requires the shared selects-ai-runtime plugin from the same library commit and a Selects host with image AI, durable plugin storage, public local file/media APIs and editable Image overlays. macOS arm64 and Windows x64 use local RVM through selects.ai; no credits or external Python/Node are needed for the ordinary photo workflow. The existing person/main-subject inputs remain accepted without a subject-class precheck; RVM results vary for objects and animals.

inputs.label: Hero photo
inputs.hint: A photo with people; the title goes behind them.

inputs.label: Long shots
inputs.hint: Three shots of at least 3.6 s: under each grid and before the ending.

inputs.label: Clips
inputs.hint: For the two beat montages and the grids, in the order picked.

inputs.label: Song
inputs.hint: A song with a clear beat; the cuts follow its drum hits.

prepare: 26 travel videos, 1 photo with people in it and 1 song with a clear beat
